warning.titlePre: Jaguar F-Pace D180 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: The F-Pace D180 uses the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre diesel engine. Across this engine family - including its use in F-Pace's platform siblings XE, XF, and Velar - timing chain and injector seal wear is a confirmed pattern. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
Other F-Pace variants with petrol Ingenium engines do not share this specific issue.
warning.source: Source: widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages, consistent with broader Ingenium pattern per VRF-jaguar-f-pace.md. Applies to AJ200D; other F-Pace petrol variants explicitly excluded per VRF.
